decisions.text: Public launch moves to Tuesday, November 17; the release build goes to App Store review by Friday, November 6 with manual release.
The beta runs on external TestFlight, capped at 500 testers, invited in two waves of 250.
Use PostHog (EU cloud, session replay off) for analytics; Mixpanel is out on pricing.
Pricing is $3.99 per month or $29.99 per year with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan, and no lifetime plan for now.
No paid ads in launch week; the roughly $4,000 budget goes to creators, and paid ads are revisited in December.

actions.task: Build the release candidate and submit it for App Store review with manual release by Friday, November 6.
Write the analytics event list, share it, and integrate the PostHog SDK before beta wave one.
Put together the press kit and send it to Northlight.
Confirm and brief the five creators, get contracts signed, and give them TestFlight access.
Write the App Store listing copy (description, subtitle, keywords, screenshot captions).
Ask Tom in legal to update the privacy policy and check the App Privacy answers for PostHog before submission.
Send beta wave one invites to the first 250 people on the waitlist.

traps.text: Launch on Tuesday, November 10 (decided early, later moved to November 17).
Speaker 2 writes the App Store listing copy (moved to You later).
Any decision on Android launch timing (same day, open beta, or later); it was left open for next week.
